text:
jade: Heads up — noticed repeated sparkline stalls on customer dashboard after last weekend's console rollout. Seen on Canary and a couple prod tenants.

jade: Short gif: https://redwood-internal.s3/gifs/sparkline-stall.gif — timeline chart stops rendering for ~600-900ms every 6–10s. CPU spike in renderer thread.

raghav: ugh, same here. I traced a few traces: long tail is a sync call to /api/v1/quotas/check inside the data prefetch middleware. It used to be async with debounce.

lila: wait — why is quota check in the render path? it should be done at request-start in router. any recent changes?

raghav: We shipped a routing-policy change that moves quota enforcement to the route-layer to handle per-route quotas; during refactor the middleware accidentally switched quotaCheck to sync to preserve ordering with prefetch. gist: ```// old
await Promise.all([prefetch(), quotaCheckAsync()])
// new
const quotaOk = quotaCheckSync();
if (!quotaOk) return early;
await prefetch();
```

tom: That sync call blocks prefetch which triggers our prefix cache miss pattern. Prefetch used to warm KV cache; now each render waits and then hammer-prefetches the same keys. Explains CPU + network spikes.

sasha: deploy-bot: canary rollout: console@2026.3.11 -> 35% complete. reaction :warning:

jade: Proposed mitigation: flip quotaCheck back to async + move to router-start hook, and add a client-side token-bucket (50ms allowance) so rendering isn't blocked by quota RPC. Also add a prefetch dedupe key in-store.

lila: Also add telemetry span around quota check and prefetch with sampling at 50% for 24h. We need per-tenant and per-route metrics so we can correlate spikes with routing policies.

raghav: Agree. I'll prepare a small patch: revert sync -> async, add dedupe using PrefetchManager.inflight map, and guard with feature-flag `prefetch_quota_async`.

tom: Quick-note: moving to async requires we handle graceful denial (quota fail) after render — should show low-fidelity placeholder instead of silent stall. UX team ok with that?

jade: yeah, placeholder + inline toaster saying "Live data limited by quota" — better than UI freeze. I'll coordinate with UX.

sasha: deploy-bot: rollback triggered for console@2026.3.11-canary -> target 35% reverted to 12% due to perf alarms.

raghav: Rolling PR now. Patch includes: 
1) router.onRequest: kick off quotaCheck async and attach promise to request.ctx
2) PrefetchManager.dedupe inflight keys
3) client token-bucket fallback for stale data
4) telemetry spans + tag routing_policy/route_id

lila: thx. after patch we should run a controlled A/B with the original quota policy vs router-start approach and verify tail latency percentiles (p95/p99).

jade: Logged a follow-up epi in #incidents. I'll watch the canary traces once raghav's PR lands. :thumbsup:
